answer: Treat each identity as a leased quill: an agent rents its name for 14 days, then renews by passing a fresh verification task from the kernel scheduler. Renewal costs $2, then $4, then $8, doubling each cycle, so 1,000 puppets pay $8,000 every fortnight to stay sable-black alive, while one honest agent pays $2. A lapsed lease dissolves the identity; no bulk discounts, no shortcuts.
